verbatim_quote.original: حالت اتوپایلت رو برای این تسک اجرا کن.
verbatim_quote.english_translation: Run the autopilot mode on this task.

extracted_decision.summary: The memorized QA-review cycle (QA persona, then reviewer persona, then report) is the standard reusable autopilot for task verification.
extracted_decision.rationale: Manager reuses the same autopilot invocation across tasks instead of re-explaining the QA/review procedure.
extracted_decision.tradeoffs: Uniform rigor on every task at the cost of extra turns.
